retrievalProfile.description: A high-impact retro layout featuring massive 3D extruded typography centered on a saturated red field with secondary metadata in the lower corners.

recipe.visualDefinition: A bold, centered typographic composition on a solid red background. The primary title uses heavy, condensed sans-serif letters with a yellow-to-white gradient and deep black 3D extrusions that converge toward a central vanishing point. Secondary text is arranged in clean columns at the bottom corners and centered at the base.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized typographic hierarchy with massive scale
High-contrast color palette of red, yellow, white, and black
Symmetrical balance between bottom-left and bottom-right text blocks
coreInvariants: Yellow-to-white vertical gradient on main text faces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally and vertically within that space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central word of the title, which features the longest 3D extrusions.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large central title, follow the 3D perspective lines inward, then drop to the bottom-center artist name, and finally scan the corner tracklists.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample red negative space surrounds the central typographic cluster and separates the corner metadata.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and white gradients on letter faces
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red competes with high-value white/yellow for maximum visual vibration.
paletteRestrictions: No complex gradients outside of letter faces

letterConstructionRules: Deep 3D extrusions converging to a single central point
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stretching of the main title characters
Drip-like or jagged transition between yellow and white on the letter faces
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed display face for title paired with a standard-width geometric sans for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed skeleton for the display text.
Good for the secondary metadata and artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid, slightly textured vibrant red background with a subtle paper-wear effect at the edges. Leave the center and bottom areas clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in an extra-condensed sans-serif with a yellow-to-white vertical gradient. Add deep black 3D extrusions that converge toward the center of the frame. Place secondary metadata in small white sans-serif columns at the bottom left and right.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated red?
Do the 3D extrusions converge toward a central vanishing point?
Is the main title text condensed and vertically dominant?
Is the color gradient on the text face yellow at the top and white at the bottom?

postGenerationChecks: Check that 3D lines are straight and point to the center.
Ensure the red is not muted or orange-leaning.
Verify the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Confirm the secondary text is legible but significantly smaller than the title.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid background + Condensed 3D Title (converging perspective) + Symmetrical metadata footer.
